binding.scope: Literal CAD/interface binding only; independent model parameters below are assumptions

assumptions: Generic BJT beta/diode/ESD/supervisor assumptions, not vendor macro-models
Connected bus pullups track the carrier rail; disconnected supply cases use3.3V bus, with a separate3.63V bus-only case
Steady ±18V is a conditional bench experiment, not a protected-input rating or automotive pulse qualification
Open wires/short-to-return are indistinguishable from valid contact states
Unpowered IC and full-temperature loaded reset behavior remain unknown
3V3-feed and bus-feed currents are separate; neither includes ESP32/carrier loads or switching peaks; no headroom or thermal qualification
